summary: Partial chronology review of Jinshu 020 units s0037–s0046 (Wu Yan/Sima Yan three-year mourning and Taishi 2 month 8 edict). The 泰始二年八月 edict anchors a specific reign-month; retrospective three-year mourning rules s0037–s0038 are undated precedent narrative. Two official attestation intervals (claims 11–12) over-attach Taishi 1–2 Western years to the s0043 memorial advice rather than to a sourced tenure event. Empress Dowager Wang hint claim 18 needs clearer event ownership at s0038. Remaining 646 packet items and 746 units are explicitly out of scope for this checkpoint.
